about.name: Corentin
about.bio: I'm a full-stack developer based in Brussels, Belgium. I enjoy building modern, scalable web applications with a focus on clean code and great user experience. I'm currently working at Eachstapp, where I contribute to enterprise web applications using React, Next.js, and .NET. I studied Computer Science at Haute École Léonard de Vinci, where I built my foundation in software engineering.

zeus.name: Zeus
zeus.description: Needed a fast, multilingual portfolio — built it with Next.js 16 and zero client JS on the main page.
zeus.longDescription: Zeus is my personal portfolio website built to showcase my skills, experience, and projects. It features full internationalization (EN/FR), dark mode by default, a contact form that forwards messages to a Discord webhook, SEO metadata, and a clean component architecture using shadcn/ui. The site is deployed on Vercel with analytics and speed insights integrated.

fullStackDev.name: Full Stack Developer
fullStackDev.description: Leading the development and maintenance of enterprise web applications using React, Next.js, and .NET technologies. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to architect scalable solutions, implement RESTful APIs, and optimize application performance. Successfully delivered multiple features that improved user engagement and system efficiency while maintaining high code quality standards.

internship.name: Fullstack Developer (Internship)
internship.description: Contributed to the development of modern web applications by implementing responsive frontend components and backend API integrations. Gained practical experience with React, TypeScript, and .NET while working in an agile development environment. Participated in code reviews, sprint planning sessions, and learned industry best practices for building production-ready applications.

education.name: Computer Science Student
education.description: Completed comprehensive studies in computer science covering programming fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, database management, and software engineering principles. Developed strong analytical and problem-solving skills through hands-on projects and coursework. Built a solid foundation in object-oriented programming, web development, and system design that directly applies to modern software development practices.
